fact_text: Clifton's high-rise and commercial build-out accelerated from the 2000s, after main roads were declared commercial, and the reporter linked it to Karachi's growing population.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: Old Clifton houses trade close to land value because buyers demolish them and rebuild, so the structure adds little to the price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: Clifton's original scheme plots were about 2,000 square yards, and owners later subdivided them into 400 to 600 square yard plots as the land was divided and commercialised.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: On 27 Jul 2025 a 400 square yard old-style Clifton house was put at a minimum of about PKR 10 crore, with the top of the range at about PKR 20 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: On 27 Jul 2025 Clifton house prices were lowest in Blocks 1 and 2 and rose toward the Block 5 and Block 8 areas, which the reporter called the hottest areas.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: Clifton Block 5 is the largest and most developed block, with about 15 to 16 parks, a count the reporter gave with some uncertainty.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: Clifton commercial space started at about PKR 25,000 per square foot at launch, and bookings in 2025 were reported at about PKR 35,000 per square foot.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: New Clifton commercial towers offer office units with covered areas from about 700 to 2,500 square feet.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: Commercial activity is moving from older areas such as Tariq Road into Clifton, where residential builders have added office towers and converted plots to commercial use.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: On 27 Jul 2025 several banks, including HBL and the bank behind the Habib Bank Plaza, had moved or shifted head offices to Clifton, the reporter said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: A Clifton Block 1 plot of more than 5,000 square yards is said to carry high-rise permission, and several developers have bought land nearby for high-rise projects.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: On 27 Jul 2025 a brand-new two-bedroom Clifton apartment of about 1,200 square feet was priced at about PKR 3 crore, with booking payments starting at that level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: A new Clifton tower offers four-bedroom sea-facing flats of about 4,000 square feet covered area, with amenities on the seventh floor and on the rooftop.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: On 27 Jul 2025 three- to five-bedroom units in that new Clifton tower were quoted from about PKR 8 crore at the low end to about PKR 18 crore at the top.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: Five-bedroom units in that new Clifton tower include a private infinity pool and three reserved car parking spaces, the reporter said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: A Clifton high-rise shown in the video is about 40 storeys tall, and a commercial project there has a mall at ground level with about 20 floors of offices above.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: As land gets costlier and families grow, buyers in Clifton are shifting from bungalows and ground-level houses toward basements and vertical apartment living, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: The interviewee said traditional buyers accept smaller covered space for open living, while newer buyers ask for amenities and some buy Clifton apartments mainly as investments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: The interviewee called Clifton the best prime location in Karachi for long-term living and investment, while noting that other Karachi areas also offer investment options.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)

fact_text: The interviewee expected the high-rise project shown in the video to start handing over possession at the finishing stage in about two years from July 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Clifton Karachi Property: Prices, History & Investment | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-27)
